title: Mayday Over SFO, Kirby Airs All His Grievances, and Delta Quietly Wins the Widebody War
summary: A United 757 declares an emergency over San Francisco when a go-around burns through its fuel reserves. Then, United CEO Scott Kirby has a lot of feelings about American Airlines and a theory about Boeing and Airbus you have to hear. Plus, Delta quietly becomes the only U.S. airline flying Airbus's newest widebodies, and Alaska Airlines cuts 200 jobs as fuel costs keep biting.
